about: SDK 3.1.0: which answers of the server stop a model already on the device (make_model_gate.py; SPEC.md 15.3 and 15.4; every message and fix is the catalogue's). The rule: an answer stops a model exactly when its body carries a `reason` that is one of `stop_reasons`; an answer without a reason never does. `from` is `api` or `cdn` (a model request); `status` and `body` are the answer (both null: no answer). `expect.stops_model`: the refusal is remembered and client.model() and prefetch fail with `expect.error` until a later answer accepts the key. `expect.removes_models` (format 3, always equal to stops_model): with the stop the SDK removes every model build it holds from the device, so the model is downloaded again once the key is accepted. `expect.error`: the error the call raises when it cannot give a model, or null. A stop's error is server_rejected with the reason's entry, or invalid_key for the reasons of `key_reasons`. `model_request_reasons` are refusals of a model request that never stop a model. `app` fills {origin}; `sdk` fills {sdk}.

error.fix: Use an apps key on Android and iOS, a desktop key on macOS, Windows and Linux, and a web key in a browser page; sdk.quranlab.ai makes each of them under the same app.

cases.name: API 403 app_blocked, reason app_blocked
cases.about: The app is blocked by Quran Lab or paused by its developer. It ends when a later answer accepts the key.

error.message: Quran Lab does not serve this app at the moment: it is blocked by Quran Lab or paused by its developer (app_blocked).
error.fix: Open the app's page on sdk.quranlab.ai: unpause the app there, or read the reason for the block and write to Quran Lab from the account that owns the app.

cases.name: API 403 developer_not_approved, reason developer_not_approved

error.message: The account behind this key has no access to Quran Lab yet (developer_not_approved).
error.fix: Open https://sdk.quranlab.ai/start with the account that owns the key and finish the access request; the key works as soon as access is given.

cases.name: API 503 network_blocked
cases.about: The network the request came from is not served (`retry_after`). Not a refusal of the key: try later or from another network.

cases.name: CDN 503 network_blocked
cases.about: The same on a model request (the header `retry-after`).

cases.name: CDN 403 model_attestation_required
cases.about: This install's token is valid and not attested where the server asks for an attested one. A refusal of this install's request, not of the key: the download fails with this error, and a model already on the device keeps running.

error.message: Quran Lab could not confirm that this is the app as its store delivers it, running on a real device, and does not send it the model (model_attestation_required).
error.fix: Run the app as the store or TestFlight installs it, on a real device: a simulator, an emulator and a changed app or device cannot be confirmed. While you develop, use this app's development key, which is not asked for this.

cases.name: CDN 403 model_not_allowed
cases.about: The platform is switched off for model files.

error.message: Quran Lab does not send model files to this platform at the moment (model_not_allowed).
error.fix: Nothing in the app is wrong. See sdk.quranlab.ai for the state of this platform, or write to Quran Lab from the account that owns the app.

cases.name: CDN 429 model_limit
cases.about: A daily limit of the install or the key (`scope`), with `retry-after`: try later, never a refusal. The download fails with download_failed and is not repeated in a loop.

error.message: The model download stopped: Quran Lab's daily limit for model downloads is reached; try again later.
error.fix: Call model() or prefetch() again when the network is back; the download resumes where it stopped.

cases.name: API 429 rate_limited
cases.about: Back off; not a refusal.

cases.name: API 403 sdk_too_old
cases.about: The floor's answer keeps doing what it did in 3.0: its own error when the server is needed, and a model on the device keeps running.

body.message: This key needs a newer SDK.

error.message: This key needs SDK 3.2.0 or later; this is 3.1.0.
error.fix: Upgrade the TajweedFormer SDK to 3.2.0 or later (the min_sdk of the server's answer), with the install line of the README.

cases.name: API 403 environment_mismatch
cases.about: A development key in a published build, or the other way round: an error that says so, not a stop.

error.message: This key's environment (development or production) does not match this app (environment_mismatch).
error.fix: Use the development key in the builds you run yourself and the production key in the build you publish; both are on the app's page on sdk.quranlab.ai.
